errors.description: Bounding terminal members' size: the inequality should read 2^{|D|-1} ≤ w(D\{p}) since p is excluded from the product; the stated 2^{|D|} is off by one factor. The conclusion |D| ≤ a_1 remains valid, so this is a harmless typo.

parsed.notes: Clean, complete argument: greedy-scan reinterpretation, support-only acceptance, self-dual family F, minimal supports C, infinite sunflower lemma giving finiteness of bounded-size minimal supports, weight-descent lemma forcing every prime into a bounded-size 'terminal' support, hence C finite and acceptance periodic mod L. All steps verified; only a trivial exponent typo.
